implementation: Independent native reader; no upstream installer code or binaries are executed or linked.
container: One or more DEADBEEF groups, 288-byte __NAILZHUFLIB member headers, original-size prefix then standard adaptive LH1, 17-byte NAISIGN group trailers. Original producer has a final size u32 and no manifest; v1.2 uses170-byte manifest records and297-byte signing area plus final size/start/count integers; later layouts use178-byte records and _SUPERDAT_HEADER footer before an optional PE certificate.
limitations: Member filenames must be safe ASCII paths. Group NAISIGN checksum semantics and modern manifest type2 Olympus DAT-checksum domain are not identified; these vendor checksums are not claimed as verified. Ordinary manifest CRC32 values are validated. Nine ARC9 packages (176members) match the independent reference extraction byte-for-byte. Unsupported layouts and codecs fail explicitly. TEST decodes to a CRC sink without payload staging; extraction validates before creating a destination and streams a second pass. Type2 members without the exact Olympus header still require an exact ordinary CRC match.
